_comment: Created 2026-10-07 with no in-game capture, so the description is TBD rather than guessed. Art pending. Built ahead of Season 5 because EA's Sep 30, 2026 Community Update ("Siege of Vegas Incoming") says "With Season 5, we're prioritizing Rapid Royale Solos and will be removing Gauntlet from the active playlist lineup" - a removal is recorded in data/releases.json, and a 'removed' slug with no item file is a hard failure. That sentence is an announcement, not an observation: no Removed row until the playlist is actually seen without it. The Playlist row is sourced: data/releases.json lists Gauntlet under REDSEC in 1.1.1.0, and EA files its lines under its REDSEC heading. The bare alias deliberately catches EA's variant names too ("Gauntlet: Fighter Sweep", "Gauntlet: Rodeo", "Gauntlet Nightfall", "Ice Lock Gauntlet"): EA names each one as a Gauntlet mode, so those lines belong here as well as on any variant's own page.
name: Gauntlet
_art_note: Art is the little badge the game prints beside GAME MODE, not a scene, so it renders at icon size rather than filling the art column. Not captured yet; the tile stays pending rather than borrowing another mode's glyph. Custom Search covers core multiplayer only, so a REDSEC capture is the likelier source - and after Season 5 removes the mode from the playlist there may be no screen left to capture it from.
